title: ononis spinosa subsp. antiquorum
intro: Ononis spinosa subsp. antiquorum, commonly known as Old World sainfoin or Burdock, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family. This perennial herb has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Ononis spinosa subsp. antiquorum are attributed to its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
